verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data, and no test API keys or separate workspaces. The only related feature is the in-builder "Test call" for draft agent versions. That is a way to preview an agent, not a sandbox that keeps test activity away from production contacts and call data, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
